page.content:
Successor that revives replicant production after the Blackout.

How Wallace Corporation connects

  • Character: Niander Wallace — Wallace owns the corporation that replaced Tyrell.
  • Character: Joi — Joi is a Wallace consumer product.
  • Faction: Tyrell Corporation — Wallace Corporation succeeds the fallen Tyrell empire.

What is Wallace Corporation?

Wallace Corporation, under Niander Wallace, absorbs what remains of Tyrell and manufactures a new generation of obedient replicants — and Joi.

Key threads lead to Niander Wallace, Joi and Tyrell Corporation.
